elevate.move: Give services a lead job: promote Sand & refinish to a wide feature row spanning both columns with its own process frame and the full 36-to-COAT-3 mini-rail, then let the other nine fall below as a lighter ruled index ordered coarse to fine, each tagged with its grit stamp; bring the CTA strip back onto the same 128px column so the page has one left edge.

Turn the drawn imagery into one art-directed set that tracks the grit: each image rendered at the texture coarseness of its place in the sequence (swirl speckle at 36, clean grain at 100, raking-light satin at COAT 3), and give the break band one strong window-light streak so it becomes the page's finished-floor image instead of a blurred filler.
